name: topk_transform_paged_page_size64_has_page_tables_topk512
description: Select each row's topk highest scores among its first seq_lens candidates; write their positions, or their page slots, padded with -1.

n_candidates.description: Candidate scores per row, 4-float aligned rows.

seq_lens.description: Valid candidates per row, a prefix the page table covers.

page_tables.description: Page of each page_size candidates, distinct within a row.

out_page_indices.description: Selected positions, or page_tables slots when passed; -1 after a short row's entries.

sources.content:
"""Paged top-k page-slot select in FlyDSL: a chunk kernel picks each score chunk's top-k with an exact radix select on
an order-preserving key, and a merge kernel selects again over the chunks' candidates of rows with several chunks.
seq_lens is read on the device, so nothing is read back on the host.
"""

import functools

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import torch
from flydsl._mlir import ir
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm as _llvm
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import rocdl as _rocdl
from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr

NT = 512  # threads per workgroup
WAVE = 64
WAVE_SHIFT = WAVE.bit_length() - 1
NW = NT // WAVE
TOPK = 512
PAGE = 64
PAGE_SHIFT = PAGE.bit_length() - 1
CHUNK = 16384  # scores per chunk workgroup
CHUNK_SHIFT = CHUNK.bit_length() - 1
VEC = 4  # scores per 16 B load
VPT = CHUNK // (NT * VEC)  # 16 B loads per thread
PPC = CHUNK // PAGE  # pages per chunk
KEY_BITS = 32
DIGIT_BITS = 8
BINS = 1 << DIGIT_BITS
PASSES = KEY_BITS // DIGIT_BITS
CNT_BITS = 16  # the emit scan packs the greater and equal counts into one word
INT_MIN = -(2**31)


def _rsrc(tensor, nbytes):
    return fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(fx.get_iter(tensor), num_records_bytes=nbytes))


def _load(rsrc, elem_off, vec=1, mask=None):
    """Load vec i32 at element offset elem_off; masked-off lanes read out of bounds (zeros)."""
    boff = elem_off * fx.Int32(4)
    if mask is not None:
        boff = mask.select(boff, fx.Int32(0x7FFFFFF0))
    i32 = ir.IntegerType.get_signless(32)
    ty = i32 if vec == 1 else ir.VectorType.get([vec], i32)
    return fx.rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(ty, rsrc, boff, 0)


def _store(val, rsrc, elem_off):
    boff = elem_off * fx.Int32(4)
    _rocdl.RawPtrBufferStoreOp(val.ir_value(), rsrc, boff.ir_value(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value())


def _lds_add1(ptr):
    _llvm.AtomicRMWOp(
        _llvm.AtomicBinOp.add,
        fx.to_llvm_ptr(ptr),
        fx.Int32(1).ir_value(),
        _llvm.AtomicOrdering.monotonic,
        syncscope="workgroup",
        alignment=4,
    )


def _opaque(v):
    """Identity LLVM cannot see through, so a packed bitmask is not unpacked back into per-key lane masks."""
    i32 = ir.IntegerType.get_signless(32)
    return fx.Int32(_llvm.InlineAsmOp(i32, [v.ir_value()], "v_mov_b32 $0, $1", "=v,v").result)


def _wave_reduce(v, op):
    for k in reversed(range(WAVE_SHIFT)):
        v = op(v, v.shuffle_xor(fx.Int32(1 << k), fx.Int32(WAVE)))
    return v


def _wave_scan(v, lane):
    for k in range(WAVE_SHIFT):
        y = fx.Int32(gpu.shuffle_up(v, 1 << k, WAVE))
        v = (lane >= fx.Int32(1 << k)).select(v + y, v)
    return v


@functools.cache
def _build(n_tokens, n_cand, n_pages):
    B, NC, NP = n_tokens, n_cand, n_pages
    NCH = (NC + CHUNK - 1) // CHUNK
    score_bytes = B * NC * 4
    pt_bytes = B * NP * 4
    out_bytes = B * TOPK * 4
    ws_bytes = B * NCH * TOPK * 4
    seq_bytes = B * 4

    @fx.struct
    class Smem:
        hist: fx.Array[fx.Int32, PASSES * BINS, 16]
        pt: fx.Array[fx.Int32, PPC, 16]
        wmin: fx.Array[fx.Int32, NW, 16]
        wand: fx.Array[fx.Int32, NW, 16]
        wor: fx.Array[fx.Int32, NW, 16]
        hscan: fx.Array[fx.Int32, NW, 16]
        escan: fx.Array[fx.Int32, NW, 16]
        st: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 2, 16]
        stk: fx.Array[fx.Int32, TOPK + NT, 16]
        sti: fx.Array[fx.Int32, TOPK + NT, 16]

    def make_kernel(MERGE):
        N = NCH if MERGE else VPT * VEC

        @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[NT, 1, 1])
        def topk_kernel(
            scores: fx.Tensor,
            seq_lens: fx.Tensor,
            page_tables: fx.Tensor,
            out: fx.Tensor,
            ws_key: fx.Tensor,
            ws_slot: fx.Tensor,
        ):
            tid = fx.Int32(gpu.thread_idx.x)
            lane = tid & fx.Int32(WAVE - 1)
            wave = tid >> fx.Int32(WAVE_SHIFT)
            chunk = fx.Int32(gpu.block_idx.x)
            row = fx.Int32(gpu.block_idx.y)
            c0 = fx.Int32(0)
            c1 = fx.Int32(1)
            cmin = fx.Int32(INT_MIN)

            lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Smem).peek()
            hist = lds.hist.ptr
            ptl = lds.pt.ptr
            wmin = lds.wmin.ptr
            wand = lds.wand.ptr
            wor = lds.wor.ptr
            hscan = lds.hscan.ptr
            escan = lds.escan.ptr
            st = lds.st.ptr
            stk = lds.stk.ptr
            sti = lds.sti.ptr

            seq_r = _rsrc(seq_lens, seq_bytes)
            out_r = _rsrc(out, out_bytes)
            wsk_r = _rsrc(ws_key, ws_bytes)
            wss_r = _rsrc(ws_slot, ws_bytes)
            sc_r = _rsrc(scores, score_bytes)
            pt_r = _rsrc(page_tables, pt_bytes)

            L = fx.Int32(_load(seq_r, row))
            nch = (L + fx.Int32(CHUNK - 1)) >> fx.Int32(CHUNK_SHIFT)
            if const_expr(MERGE):
                go = nch > c1
            else:
                # a row with at most TOPK candidates keeps them all, in position order
                if (L <= fx.Int32(TOPK)) & (chunk == c0):
                    pv = fx.Int32(_load(pt_r, row * fx.Int32(NP) + (tid >> fx.Int32(PAGE_SHIFT))))
                    sv = (tid < L).select(pv * fx.Int32(PAGE) + (tid & fx.Int32(PAGE - 1)), fx.Int32(-1))
                    _store(sv, out_r, row * fx.Int32(TOPK) + tid)
                go = (chunk < nch) & (L > fx.Int32(TOPK))

            if go:
                # load keys
                keys = []
                slots = []
                if const_expr(MERGE):
                    for c in range_constexpr(N):
                        valid = tid < (L - fx.Int32(c * CHUNK))
                        off = (row * fx.Int32(NCH) + fx.Int32(c)) * fx.Int32(TOPK) + tid
                        kraw = fx.Int32(_load(wsk_r, off, 1, valid))
                        sraw = fx.Int32(_load(wss_r, off, 1, valid))
                        keys.append(valid.select(kraw, cmin))
                        slots.append(sraw)
                    nvalid = fx.min(L, fx.Int32(TOPK))
                else:
                    base = chunk * fx.Int32(CHUNK)
                    rowoff = row * fx.Int32(NC)
                    vecs = []
                    for i in range_constexpr(VPT):
                        e0 = base + (fx.Int32(i * NT) + tid) * fx.Int32(VEC)
                        vecs.append(_load(sc_r, rowoff + e0, VEC, e0 < L))
                    gp = chunk * fx.Int32(PPC) + tid
                    pv = fx.Int32(_load(pt_r, row * fx.Int32(NP) + gp, 1, gp < fx.Int32(NP)))
                    if tid < fx.Int32(PPC):
                        fx.ptr_store(pv, ptl + tid)
                    for i in range_constexpr(VPT):
                        v = fx.Vector(vecs[i])
                        e0 = base + (fx.Int32(i * NT) + tid) * fx.Int32(VEC)
                        for j in range_constexpr(VEC):
                            s = fx.Int32(v[j])
                            sk = (s < c0).select(s ^ fx.Int32(~INT_MIN), s)
                            keys.append((e0 + fx.Int32(j) < L).select(sk, cmin))
                    nvalid = fx.min(fx.max(L - base, c0), fx.Int32(TOPK))

                for i in range_constexpr(PASSES * BINS // NT):
                    fx.ptr_store(c0, hist + (fx.Int32(i * NT) + tid))

                # prefilter
                tmax = keys[0]
                for j in range_constexpr(1, N):
                    tmax = fx.max(tmax, keys[j])
                tmin = _wave_reduce(tmax, fx.min)
                if lane == c0:
                    fx.ptr_store(tmin, wmin + wave)
                gpu.barrier()
                t0 = fx.ptr_load(wmin + c0)
                for w in range_constexpr(1, NW):
                    t0 = fx.min(t0, fx.ptr_load(wmin + fx.Int32(w)))

                am = c0
                aa = fx.Int32(-1)
                oo = c0
                for j in range_constexpr(N):
                    al = (keys[j] >= t0) & (keys[j] != cmin)
                    am = am | al.select(fx.Int32(1 << j), c0)
                    u = keys[j] ^ cmin
                    aa = aa & al.select(u, fx.Int32(-1))
                    oo = oo | al.select(u, c0)
                am = _opaque(am)
                aa = _wave_reduce(aa, lambda a, b: a & b)
                oo = _wave_reduce(oo, lambda a, b: a | b)
                if lane == c0:
                    fx.ptr_store(aa, wand + wave)
                    fx.ptr_store(oo, wor + wave)
                gpu.barrier()
                pa = fx.ptr_load(wand + c0)
                po = fx.ptr_load(wor + c0)
                for w in range_constexpr(1, NW):
                    pa = pa & fx.ptr_load(wand + fx.Int32(w))
                    po = po | fx.ptr_load(wor + fx.Int32(w))
                hi = fx.Int32(KEY_BITS) - fx.Int32(fx.math.ctlz(pa ^ po))
                pre0 = (hi >= fx.Int32(KEY_BITS)).select(
                    c0, pa & (fx.Int32(-1) << fx.min(hi, fx.Int32(KEY_BITS - 1)))
                )
                if tid == c0:
                    fx.ptr_store(pre0, st + c0)
                    fx.ptr_store(nvalid, st + c1)
                gpu.barrier()

                # radix passes
                for p in range_constexpr(PASSES):
                    prefix = fx.ptr_load(st + c0)
                    need = fx.ptr_load(st + c1)
                    hp = hi - fx.Int32(DIGIT_BITS * p)
                    active = (hp > c0) & (need > c0)
                    if active:
                        sh = fx.max(hp - fx.Int32(DIGIT_BITS), c0)
                        dmask = (c1 << (hp - sh)) - c1
                        hmask = (hp >= fx.Int32(KEY_BITS)).select(
                            c0, fx.Int32(-1) << fx.min(hp, fx.Int32(KEY_BITS - 1))
                        )
                        hbase = hist + fx.Int32(p * BINS)
                        pc = prefix ^ cmin
                        cdig = (cmin >> sh) & dmask
                        for j in range_constexpr(N):
                            alj = ((am >> fx.Int32(j)) & c1) != c0
                            m = alj & (((keys[j] ^ pc) & hmask) == c0)
                            if m:
                                _lds_add1(hbase + (((keys[j] >> sh) & dmask) ^ cdig))
                        gpu.barrier()
                        d = fx.Int32(BINS - 1) - (tid & fx.Int32(BINS - 1))
                        cnt = fx.ptr_load(hbase + d)
                        sc = _wave_scan(cnt, lane)
                        if (lane == fx.Int32(WAVE - 1)) & (tid < fx.Int32(BINS)):
                            fx.ptr_store(sc, hscan + wave)
                        gpu.barrier()
                        woff = c0
                        for w in range_constexpr(BINS // WAVE - 1):
                            woff = woff + (wave > fx.Int32(w)).select(fx.ptr_load(hscan + fx.Int32(w)), c0)
                        incl = sc + woff
                        excl = incl - cnt
                        hit = (tid < fx.Int32(BINS)) & (excl < need) & (need <= incl)
                        if hit:
                            fx.ptr_store(prefix | (d << sh), st + c0)
                            fx.ptr_store(need - excl, st + c1)
                    gpu.barrier()

                # emit
                tu = fx.ptr_load(st + c0)
                need_eq = fx.ptr_load(st + c1)
                ts = tu ^ cmin
                gm = c0
                em = c0
                for j in range_constexpr(N):
                    g = keys[j] > ts
                    e = (keys[j] == ts) & (ts != cmin)
                    gm = gm | g.select(fx.Int32(1 << j), c0)
                    em = em | e.select(fx.Int32(1 << j), c0)
                gm = _opaque(gm)
                em = _opaque(em)
                ngt = fx.Int32(fx.math.ctpop(gm))
                neq = fx.Int32(fx.math.ctpop(em))
                packed = ngt + (neq << fx.Int32(CNT_BITS))
                ps = _wave_scan(packed, lane)
                if lane == fx.Int32(WAVE - 1):
                    fx.ptr_store(ps, escan + wave)
                gpu.barrier()
                woff = c0
                tot = c0
                for w in range_constexpr(NW):
                    wv = fx.ptr_load(escan + fx.Int32(w))
                    woff = woff + (wave > fx.Int32(w)).select(wv, c0)
                    tot = tot + wv
                exc = ps - packed + woff
                cnt_mask = fx.Int32((1 << CNT_BITS) - 1)
                rg = exc & cnt_mask
                re = exc >> fx.Int32(CNT_BITS)
                total_gt = tot & cnt_mask
                dummy = fx.Int32(TOPK) + tid
                # compact the winners into LDS: no branches, losers write a per-thread dummy word
                for j in range_constexpr(N):
                    g = (gm >> fx.Int32(j)) & c1
                    e = (em >> fx.Int32(j)) & c1
                    te = (e != c0) & (re < need_eq)
                    pos = (g != c0).select(rg, te.select(total_gt + re, dummy))
                    if const_expr(MERGE):
                        fx.ptr_store(slots[j], sti + pos)
                    else:
                        i = j // VEC
                        jj = j % VEC
                        fx.ptr_store(keys[j], stk + pos)
                        fx.ptr_store((fx.Int32(i * NT) + tid) * fx.Int32(VEC) + fx.Int32(jj), sti + pos)
                    rg = rg + g
                    re = re + e
                gpu.barrier()
                kk = total_gt + need_eq
                win = tid < kk
                outrow = row * fx.Int32(TOPK)
                if const_expr(MERGE):
                    sv = fx.ptr_load(sti + tid)
                    _store(win.select(sv, fx.Int32(-1)), out_r, outrow + tid)
                else:
                    idx = win.select(fx.ptr_load(sti + tid), c0)
                    kv = fx.ptr_load(stk + tid)
                    pg = fx.ptr_load(ptl + (idx >> fx.Int32(PAGE_SHIFT)))
                    slot = win.select(pg * fx.Int32(PAGE) + (idx & fx.Int32(PAGE - 1)), fx.Int32(-1))
                    if nch <= c1:
                        _store(slot, out_r, outrow + tid)
                    else:
                        wsrow = (row * fx.Int32(NCH) + chunk) * fx.Int32(TOPK)
                        _store(win.select(kv, cmin), wsk_r, wsrow + tid)
                        _store(slot, wss_r, wsrow + tid)

        return topk_kernel

    chunk_kernel = make_kernel(False)
    merge_kernel = make_kernel(True)

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        scores: fx.Tensor,
        seq_lens: fx.Tensor,
        page_tables: fx.Tensor,
        out: fx.Tensor,
        ws_key: fx.Tensor,
        ws_slot: fx.Tensor,
        stream: fx.Stream,
    ):
        chunk_kernel(scores, seq_lens, page_tables, out, ws_key, ws_slot).launch(
            grid=(NCH, B, 1), block=(NT, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )
        merge_kernel(scores, seq_lens, page_tables, out, ws_key, ws_slot).launch(
            grid=(1, B, 1), block=(NT, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )

    return launch, NCH


def run(*, scores, seq_lens, metadata, out_page_indices, page_size, page_tables):
    B, NC = scores.shape
    NP = page_tables.shape[1]
    launch, nch = _build(B, NC, NP)
    ws = torch.empty((2, B, nch, TOPK), dtype=torch.int32, device=scores.device)
    launch(
        scores,
        seq_lens,
        page_tables,
        out_page_indices,
        ws[0],
        ws[1],
        fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(scores.device)),
    )
